Meet Our Leadership

New Chapter Housing & Care Services is a family-owned business led by brother and sister Chris K. Kochakyan and Star A. Kochakyan. Together, they bring hands-on senior living, healthcare administration and care coordination experience to every family they serve.

Chris K. Kochakyan

Founder & Senior Living Advisor

Chris is dedicated to helping individuals and families make confident, informed decisions and find compassionate care that fits their unique needs.

Star A. Kochakyan

Senior Living Placement Director

With nearly two decades in senior living and healthcare administration, Star provides knowledgeable, personalized support throughout the placement journey.

“Every family deserves compassion, honesty and someone they can trust.”

Resources for Families

Helpful starting points for families preparing for placement, care coordination or an urgent transition.

Preparing for Placement

Gather a medication list, diagnoses, mobility needs, preferred location, budget information and any discharge or care instructions.

Questions to Ask

Ask about staffing, supervision, meals, transportation, medication support, activities, visiting policies and fees.

CalAIM & ALWP

Eligibility and availability vary. Our team can help you understand the programs and identify practical next steps.
